title: Agent Joules price table (REQ-009)
description: config/prices.json: one row per priced model. Every row carries its source and the day it was read, and both prices are above 0, so a free tier or an unsourced price cannot be written as a price of 0. Passing this schema is necessary but not sufficient: the loader additionally requires a well-formed absolute https URI with a host, a non-blank modelId (by Unicode white space), a finite price and no repeated member.

tier.description: A tier whose cost comes from a per-token price; local and cloudgpu are priced by electricity and rental, but the name is accepted so a later change needs no schema change.

modelId.description: The model ID as the tier's endpoint names it.

inputUsdPer1M.description: USD per 1 000 000 input tokens, strictly above 0.

outputUsdPer1M.description: USD per 1 000 000 output tokens, strictly above 0.

sourceUrl.description: The https page the price was read from: only the characters RFC 3986 allows in a URI (letters, digits and -._~:/?#[]!$&'()*+,;=%), so no space, no control or non-ASCII character, no quote, angle bracket, caret or backslash, and no at sign, which means no credentials (userinfo) can be written. The lookahead after the end anchor refuses a final line feed, which a .NET regular expression would let the end anchor skip.

retrievedDate.description: The day the page was read, yyyy-MM-dd.
